== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34697) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Lima DS HD.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 23 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 23 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>f2bb1e533bda662cb0a561439faa40659969929dbd54c6d9f974fdb5a9f26c9e</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

GEMP foil-display modifiers retained in the original import: <nowiki>200_110*</nowiki>. These visual settings did not create additional historical foil publications in the article.
